bandReport.notes: 31 questions, Q43-Q73 contiguous with no gaps. BAND EDGES both verified from the neighbouring pages rather than assumed: p06 (B1's last page) ends with Q42 complete, all four options present, so nothing spills onto my p07 and Q43 starts clean at the head of the left column; p12 (B3's first page) opens with Q74 at the head of the left column, so Q73 on my p11 is the last question of my band and its option block ends inside the right column above the footer. NO shared Directions/code block anywhere in this band - every question prints its own four options directly beneath its own stem in its own column, and there is no run of option-less items. Subject boundaries inside the band: Q43-Q49 Biology, Q50 Chemistry (the single Chemistry item here, and it sits at the foot of p07's right column immediately after the Biology run), Q51-Q70 History (Modern + Ancient + Medieval, interleaved rather than blocked), Q71-Q73 Economics beginning mid-page in p11's right column. Two-column hazard checked question by question on every page: p08 in particular has Q52's four-row Code table in the left column sitting directly alongside Q54's and Q55's option blocks in the right column, and Q57's four-row pairs table on p09 sits alongside Q59's and Q60's options - all four were re-read at 6x from the source PDF to confirm the label-to-text pairing came from the correct column. Page quality is good throughout; the only artefact is Hindi bleed-through from the reverse of each leaf, which is clearly distinguishable from the English text and was ignored. No printed defect found: every one of the 31 questions has exactly four options labelled (a)-(d), no duplicated option text, no missing fourth option, no impossible value.
